text: 天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来
pinyin: tiān shēng wǒ cái bì yǒu yòng, qiān jīn sàn jìn huán fù lái
literal: heaven · give birth · my · talent · surely · has · use, thousand · gold · scatter · exhausted · again · return
natural: Heaven made my talent for a purpose; spend a thousand in gold and it will come back again

meaning.en: Everyone's talent will find its use, and lost fortune can be regained; quoted for confidence and resilience.
meaning.zh: 上天生我有才必有用处，钱财花光了还会再来，表达自信与豁达。

equivalents: my talents will find a use
I was born to be useful

examples.zh: 失业后他安慰自己：“天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来”。
examples.en: After losing his job he consoled himself: '§'.

examples.zh: “天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来”，别灰心，机会总会来的。
examples.en: '§': don't lose heart, chances will come.

story.en: In 'Bring in the Wine', Li Bai drinks with friends and, despite his frustrated career, declares his confidence in his own worth.
story.zh: 李白《将进酒》：仕途不顺，仍自信才华必有用武之地。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月
pinyin: rén shēng dé yì xū jìn huān, mò shǐ jīn zūn kōng duì yuè
literal: life · succeed · must · fully · enjoy, do not · let · golden · goblet · emptily · face · moon
natural: When life goes well, enjoy it to the full; never let a golden cup face the moon empty

meaning.en: Enjoy the good times while they last; often a toast or a carpe diem line.
meaning.zh: 得意时就要尽情欢乐，不要让酒杯空对明月，劝人及时行乐。

examples.zh: 聚会上他举杯说：“人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月”。
examples.en: At the party he raised his glass and said, '§'.

examples.zh: “人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月”，今晚不醉不归！
examples.en: '§': we're not going home sober tonight!

story.en: From Li Bai's 'Bring in the Wine', urging his friends to drink and enjoy the moment.
story.zh: 李白《将进酒》劝友人尽情饮酒，及时行乐。

usage.en: Often a toast or a carpe diem line; literary, lighthearted.
usage.zh: 常作祝酒词或及时行乐之语，书面语，轻松。

text: 长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海
pinyin: cháng fēng pò làng huì yǒu shí, zhí guà yún fān jì cāng hǎi
literal: long · wind · break · waves · will · have · time, straight · hang · cloud · sails · cross · blue · sea
natural: The day will come to ride the wind and break the waves, hoisting cloud-high sails to cross the sea

meaning.en: Confidence that you will achieve your ambition after setbacks; a favourite line for encouragement.
meaning.zh: 相信总有一天会乘风破浪、实现理想，表达在逆境中的信心。

equivalents: my day to ride the waves will come

examples.zh: 高考前，老师在黑板上写下“长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海”。
examples.en: Before the exam the teacher wrote '§' on the blackboard.

examples.zh: 创业虽难，但他相信“长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海”。
examples.en: Starting a business is hard, but he believes '§'.

story.en: The closing lines of Li Bai's first 'Hard Road' poem: despite frustration, he trusts that he will cross the sea one day.
story.zh: 李白《行路难》其一结尾，在苦闷之后表达对未来的信心。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪伦送我情
pinyin: táo huā tán shuǐ shēn qiān chǐ, bù jí wāng lún sòng wǒ qíng
literal: peach · blossom · pool · water · deep · thousand · feet, not · reach · Wang Lun · see off · me · feeling
natural: Peach Blossom Pool is a thousand feet deep, yet not as deep as Wang Lun's feeling in seeing me off

meaning.en: Friendship is deeper than the deepest pool; quoted for the warmth of a friend's farewell.
meaning.zh: 桃花潭水再深也比不上汪伦送别的情谊，赞美深厚的友情。

equivalents: a friendship deeper than the pool

examples.zh: 同学们送别他时，他想起了“桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪伦送我情”。
examples.en: As classmates saw him off, he recalled '§'.

examples.zh: 毕业留言册上写满了“桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪伦送我情”。
examples.en: The graduation album was filled with '§'.

story.en: Li Bai was leaving Jingxian when his friend Wang Lun came to see him off, stamping and singing on the shore.
story.zh: 李白将乘舟离开泾县，汪伦踏歌岸边相送，李白作此诗。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 故人西辞黄鹤楼，烟花三月下扬州
pinyin: gù rén xī cí huáng hè lóu, yān huā sān yuè xià yáng zhōu
literal: old · friend · west · take leave of · Yellow Crane · Tower, misty · blossoms · third · month · go down to · Yangzhou
natural: My old friend bids farewell to Yellow Crane Tower in the west; in the misty blossoms of March he goes down to Yangzhou

meaning.en: A friend's spring departure by river to a glorious city; used for scenic travel and farewells.
meaning.zh: 老朋友在黄鹤楼告别，在春光烂漫的三月顺流去扬州，描绘送别与春日出游。

examples.zh: 春天去扬州，真是“故人西辞黄鹤楼，烟花三月下扬州”。
examples.en: Going to Yangzhou in spring is truly '§'.

examples.zh: 旅游宣传片的开头就是“故人西辞黄鹤楼，烟花三月下扬州”。
examples.en: The tourism film began with '§'.

origin.source: 李白《黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵》

story.en: Li Bai saw his friend Meng Haoran off from Yellow Crane Tower as he sailed down the Yangtze to Guangling (Yangzhou).
story.zh: 李白在黄鹤楼送别孟浩然乘舟东下扬州。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 孤帆远影碧空尽，唯见长江天际流
pinyin: gū fān yuǎn yǐng bì kōng jìn, wéi jiàn cháng jiāng tiān jì liú
literal: lone · sail · distant · shadow · blue · sky · vanish, only · see · Yangtze · sky · edge · flow
natural: The lone sail's distant shadow vanishes into the blue; only the Yangtze is seen flowing to the sky's edge

meaning.en: A friend's boat disappears from sight, leaving only the river; evokes lingering regret at a parting.
meaning.zh: 友人的孤舟消失在碧空尽头，只剩长江流向天边，表达依依惜别之情。

examples.zh: 火车远去，他望着站台，想起“孤帆远影碧空尽，唯见长江天际流”。
examples.en: As the train pulled away he gazed at the platform and thought of '§'.

examples.zh: “孤帆远影碧空尽，唯见长江天际流”，送别的情景令人难忘。
examples.en: '§': the scene of the parting is unforgettable.

origin.source: 李白《黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵》

story.en: The closing couplet of the poem for Meng Haoran: Li Bai keeps watching his friend's sail until it disappears.
story.zh: 李白目送孟浩然的船远去，直到消失在天际。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山
pinyin: liǎng àn yuán shēng tí bú zhù, qīng zhōu yǐ guò wàn chóng shān
literal: two · banks · ape · sounds · cry · not · stop, light · boat · already · pass · ten thousand · layers · mountains
natural: Apes cry ceaselessly on both banks; my light boat has already passed ten thousand mountains

meaning.en: A boat speeds through the gorges; quoted for swift progress or release from trouble.
meaning.zh: 两岸猿啼不断，小船已飞过千山万岭，形容行进飞快，也比喻摆脱困境后的轻松。

equivalents: swift as a boat through the gorges

examples.zh: 提前完成任务，他有种“两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山”的轻松。
examples.en: Finishing the task early, he felt the ease of '§'.

examples.zh: 坐高铁穿过群山，真是“两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山”。
examples.en: On the high-speed train through the mountains it was truly '§'.

story.en: Li Bai, pardoned on his way into exile, sailed swiftly down the Yangtze from Baidi City to Jiangling.
story.zh: 李白遇赦，自白帝城乘舟东下江陵，心情畅快。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还
pinyin: zhāo cí bái dì cǎi yún jiān, qiān lǐ jiāng líng yī rì huán
literal: morning · leave · White Emperor · coloured · clouds · among, thousand · li · Jiangling · one · day · return
natural: At dawn I leave Baidi among the coloured clouds; in one day I return the thousand li to Jiangling

meaning.en: A very fast journey down river; used for speed and the joy of release.
meaning.zh: 早晨离开白帝城，一天就回到千里外的江陵，形容行船飞快，心情畅快。

equivalents: a thousand li in a day

examples.zh: 高铁让“朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还”成了现实。
examples.en: High-speed rail has made '§' a reality.

examples.zh: 这趟旅程快得像“朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还”。
examples.en: The trip was as fast as '§'.

story.en: The first couplet of Li Bai's poem on leaving Baidi City after receiving a pardon in 759.
story.zh: 李白759年遇赦东还，早发白帝城时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 举杯邀明月，对影成三人
pinyin: jǔ bēi yāo míng yuè, duì yǐng chéng sān rén
literal: raise · cup · invite · bright · moon, face · shadow · become · three · people
natural: I raise my cup to invite the bright moon; with my shadow we make three

meaning.en: A lonely drinker makes company of the moon and his shadow; quoted for solitude with a touch of romance.
meaning.zh: 举杯邀请明月，加上自己的影子凑成三人，写孤独中自得其乐。

equivalents: drinking alone with the moon and my shadow

examples.zh: 一个人在阳台小酌，倒有几分“举杯邀明月，对影成三人”的味道。
examples.en: Having a quiet drink alone on the balcony had something of '§'.

examples.zh: 独居的日子里，他常想起“举杯邀明月，对影成三人”。
examples.en: Living alone, he often thought of '§'.

story.en: Li Bai drinks alone among flowers with no friend beside him, so he invites the moon and his own shadow to join him.
story.zh: 李白在花间独酌无亲，邀月与影为伴。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 相看两不厌，只有敬亭山
pinyin: xiāng kàn liǎng bù yàn, zhǐ yǒu jìng tíng shān
literal: look at each other · both · not · tire, only · have · Jingting · Mountain
natural: We never tire of gazing at each other, only I and Mount Jingting

meaning.en: A quiet, intimate companionship, between a person and nature, or between kindred spirits.
meaning.zh: 相互凝望而不厌倦，只有敬亭山，形容人与山、人与知己之间的默契。

equivalents: never tiring of each other's company

examples.zh: 他和老友对坐品茶，真是“相看两不厌，只有敬亭山”。
examples.en: He sat sipping tea with his old friend: truly '§'.

examples.zh: 对着窗外的青山，她觉得“相看两不厌，只有敬亭山”。
examples.en: Facing the green hills, she felt '§'.

story.en: Li Bai sat alone before Mount Jingting; the birds had flown and the clouds drifted away, leaving only the mountain and him.
story.zh: 李白独坐敬亭山，众鸟高飞、孤云远去，唯有山与人相对。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 日照香炉生紫烟，遥看瀑布挂前川
pinyin: rì zhào xiāng lú shēng zǐ yān, yáo kàn pù bù guà qián chuān
literal: sun · shine · Incense Burner · produce · purple · mist, from afar · look · waterfall · hang · front · river
natural: Sunlight on Incense Burner Peak makes purple mist; from afar the waterfall hangs before the river

meaning.en: A vivid picture of a waterfall under the sun; quoted for Lushan scenery.
meaning.zh: 阳光照在香炉峰上升起紫烟，远看瀑布如挂在山前，描绘庐山瀑布。

equivalents: a waterfall hung in purple mist

examples.zh: 庐山脚下的景色正是“日照香炉生紫烟，遥看瀑布挂前川”。
examples.en: The scene at the foot of Lushan is just '§'.

examples.zh: 他的画作题着“日照香炉生紫烟，遥看瀑布挂前川”。
examples.en: His painting is inscribed '§'.

story.en: The opening couplet of Li Bai's 'Gazing at the Lushan Waterfall'; the next couplet is the well-known 'three thousand feet' line.
story.zh: 李白《望庐山瀑布》前两句，后两句为“飞流直下三千尺”。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 天门中断楚江开，碧水东流至此回
pinyin: tiān mén zhōng duàn chǔ jiāng kāi, bì shuǐ dōng liú zhì cǐ huí
literal: Heaven · Gate · middle · break · Chu · river · open, green · water · east · flow · reach · here · turn
natural: The Heaven Gate peaks split and the Chu river opens; green water flows east, turning at this point

meaning.en: A powerful image of a river forcing its way through mountains; quoted for majestic, forceful scenery.
meaning.zh: 天门山中断，楚江冲开，碧水东流到此回旋，形容山水壮阔与气势。

equivalents: a river breaking through the mountains

examples.zh: 长江穿过峡谷，正是“天门中断楚江开，碧水东流至此回”的景象。
examples.en: The Yangtze passing through the gorge is the very scene of '§'.

examples.zh: 导游念起了“天门中断楚江开，碧水东流至此回”。
examples.en: The guide recited '§'.

story.en: Li Bai passed Tianmen Mountain, where two peaks face each other across the Yangtze, and described the river breaking through.
story.zh: 李白途经天门山，见两山夹江，作此诗描绘长江冲开山口。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 离离原上草，一岁一枯荣
pinyin: lí lí yuán shàng cǎo, yī suì yī kū róng
literal: lush · lush · plain · on · grass, one · year · one · wither · flourish
natural: Lush grass grows on the plain; each year it withers and thrives again

meaning.en: Grass withers and returns every year; a symbol of renewal and persistence.
meaning.zh: 原上的草茂盛，每年枯萎一次又繁荣一次，象征生命的轮回与顽强。

examples.zh: 小学生都背过“离离原上草，一岁一枯荣”。
examples.en: Every primary pupil has recited '§'.

examples.zh: “离离原上草，一岁一枯荣”，他在逆境里看到了希望。
examples.en: '§': in adversity he saw hope.

origin.source: 白居易《赋得古原草送别》

story.en: Bai Juyi wrote this as a teenager, on the set theme 'ancient plain grass, seeing off a friend'; the next lines say wildfire cannot destroy it.
story.zh: 白居易少年时以“古原草送别”为题所作，下句“野火烧不尽，春风吹又生”。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 大弦嘈嘈如急雨，小弦切切如私语
pinyin: dà xián cáo cáo rú jí yǔ, xiǎo xián qiè qiè rú sī yǔ
literal: big · strings · loud · loud · like · fast · rain, small · strings · soft · soft · like · private · whispers
natural: The thick strings rumble like pelting rain; the thin strings murmur like whispers

meaning.en: A vivid description of pipa music; quoted when praising musical performance.
meaning.zh: 粗弦声如急雨，细弦声如私语，生动描写琵琶演奏，用于赞美音乐。

examples.zh: 他的二胡演奏，正有“大弦嘈嘈如急雨，小弦切切如私语”之妙。
examples.en: His erhu playing has the charm of '§'.

examples.zh: 乐评人用“大弦嘈嘈如急雨，小弦切切如私语”形容这首曲子。
examples.en: The critic described the piece with '§'.

story.en: In 'Song of the Pipa', Bai Juyi describes a travelling woman playing the pipa on a boat at night.
story.zh: 白居易《琵琶行》描写江上琵琶女的演奏。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识
pinyin: tóng shì tiān yá lún luò rén, xiāng féng hé bì céng xiāng shí
literal: same · are · world's · edge · fallen · people, meet · why · must · once · know
natural: We are both drifters at the ends of the earth; why must we have met before?

meaning.en: People in similar misfortune feel kinship even as strangers.
meaning.zh: 同是流落天涯的失意人，相遇便可相知，不必早先认识。

examples.zh: 两个异乡打工人聊了一夜，正是“同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识”。
examples.en: Two migrant workers talked all night: truly '§'.

examples.zh: “同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识”，他们一见如故。
examples.en: '§': they clicked at first meeting.

story.en: Demoted and exiled to Jiujiang, Bai Juyi hears a former courtesan play the pipa and feels a bond with her own fall in fortune.
story.zh: 白居易被贬江州，闻琵琶女身世，感同身受而发此叹。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面
pinyin: qiān hū wàn huàn shǐ chū lái, yóu bào pí pá bàn zhē miàn
literal: thousand · call · ten thousand · summon · only then · come out, still · hold · pipa · half · cover · face
natural: After a thousand calls she finally comes, still hiding half her face behind the pipa

meaning.en: Someone appears only after much urging, and shyly; also used when something long awaited finally shows up.
meaning.zh: 经过再三呼唤才出来，还抱着琵琶遮着半边脸，形容人迟迟才露面且含羞，也指期待已久的事物终于出现。

examples.zh: 新手机终于发布，真是“千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面”。
examples.en: The new phone was finally released, truly '§'.

examples.zh: 她被大家再三邀请上台，“千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面”。
examples.en: Urged repeatedly onto the stage, she came, '§'.

story.en: The pipa player is pressed to come out to the boat to play, and appears reluctantly.
story.zh: 琵琶女被再三邀请，才抱着琵琶迟迟出场。

usage.en: Often humorous when applied to a late or shy appearance.
usage.zh: 用于迟到或害羞的出场时常带幽默。

text: 回眸一笑百媚生，六宫粉黛无颜色
pinyin: huí móu yī xiào bǎi mèi shēng, liù gōng fěn dài wú yán sè
literal: turn · eyes · one · smile · hundred · charms · arise, six · palaces · powder · eyebrow-ink · no · colour
natural: One backward glance and smile brings a hundred charms; all the palace beauties lose their colour

meaning.en: A beauty so great she outshines everyone; quoted to praise a woman's loveliness.
meaning.zh: 回头一笑，千姿百态的美随之而生，宫中美女都黯然失色，形容女子绝美。

examples.zh: 她一出场，真是“回眸一笑百媚生，六宫粉黛无颜色”。
examples.en: The moment she appeared it was '§'.

examples.zh: 影评人用“回眸一笑百媚生，六宫粉黛无颜色”形容女主角。
examples.en: The critic used '§' to describe the heroine.

story.en: In 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow', Bai Juyi describes the beauty of Yang Guifei, favourite of Emperor Xuanzong.
story.zh: 白居易《长恨歌》写杨贵妃入宫受宠的美貌。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝
pinyin: zài tiān yuàn zuò bǐ yì niǎo, zài dì yuàn wéi lián lǐ zhī
literal: in · sky · wish · be · wing-to-wing · birds, on · earth · wish · be · joined · branches
natural: In heaven may we be birds flying wing to wing; on earth, trees whose branches grow together

meaning.en: A vow of inseparable love; quoted as a wedding wish or in love declarations.
meaning.zh: 在天上愿做并翼飞的鸟，在地上愿做枝干相连的树，表达永不分离的爱情誓言。

equivalents: wing to wing, branch to branch

examples.zh: 婚礼请柬上印着“在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝”。
examples.en: The wedding invitation was printed with '§'.

examples.zh: 他在情人节写下“在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝”。
examples.en: On Valentine's Day he wrote '§'.

story.en: In the poem Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei swear love on the Seventh Night, each wishing never to be parted.
story.zh: 《长恨歌》中唐玄宗与杨贵妃七夕盟誓，愿生生世世不分离。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期
pinyin: tiān cháng dì jiǔ yǒu shí jìn, cǐ hèn mián mián wú jué qī
literal: heaven · long · earth · lasting · has · time · end, this · sorrow · unending · unending · no · end · date
natural: Heaven and earth, long-lasting, will someday end; this sorrow goes on and on with no end

meaning.en: Grief that outlasts even heaven and earth; quoted for undying regret or a tragic love.
meaning.zh: 天地再久也有尽头，这份遗憾却绵绵不绝，用于形容无尽的哀恨。

examples.zh: 他对旧事的悔恨，真是“天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期”。
examples.en: His regret about the past is truly '§'.

examples.zh: 故事的结尾“天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期”，令人叹息。
examples.en: The story ends with '§', leaving readers sighing.

story.en: The final couplet of 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow': the lovers are parted forever, and the poet laments their grief.
story.zh: 《长恨歌》结尾二句，感叹爱情悲剧的遗恨无穷。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 人间四月芳菲尽，山寺桃花始盛开
pinyin: rén jiān sì yuè fāng fēi jìn, shān sì táo huā shǐ shèng kāi
literal: human · world · fourth · month · fragrant · blooms · end, mountain · temple · peach · blossoms · begin · fully · open
natural: In the human world April's blooms are finished; at the mountain temple the peach blossoms are just opening

meaning.en: A pleasant surprise: spring lingers in the hills after it has gone below.
meaning.zh: 四月山下春花已谢，山上寺里桃花才开，写山中春迟的意外之喜。

examples.zh: 到山顶才发现“人间四月芳菲尽，山寺桃花始盛开”，别有一番景致。
examples.en: Only at the summit did I find '§', a different charm.

examples.zh: 这句“人间四月芳菲尽，山寺桃花始盛开”说明海拔不同，花期各异。
examples.en: The line '§' shows that bloom dates vary with altitude.

story.en: Bai Juyi toured Dalin Temple on Mount Lu in April 817, and was delighted to find peach blossoms still in bloom.
story.zh: 白居易817年四月游庐山大林寺，见山寺桃花盛开而作。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 曾经沧海难为水，除却巫山不是云
pinyin: céng jīng cāng hǎi nán wéi shuǐ, chú què wū shān bú shì yún
literal: once · experienced · blue · sea · hard · count as · water, apart from · Wu · Mountain · not · clouds
natural: Having seen the great sea, no other water impresses; save Wu Mountain, no cloud is worth the name

meaning.en: After a great love or experience, nothing else compares; quoted for faithfulness to a lost love.
meaning.zh: 见过大海便觉其他水不足观，看过巫山云便觉其他云不算云，比喻爱情专一或眼界已高。

equivalents: after the ocean, no water compares
no one compares to my lost love

examples.zh: 他念着亡妻，说“曾经沧海难为水，除却巫山不是云”。
examples.en: Thinking of his late wife he said '§'.

examples.zh: 尝过名厨的手艺，吃别的就“曾经沧海难为水，除却巫山不是云”了。
examples.en: Having tasted the master chef's cooking, other food just is '§'.

story.en: Yuan Zhen wrote the poem in memory of his deceased wife Wei Cong, saying that no one else could compare.
story.zh: 元稹悼念亡妻韦丛所作，表示再无人可比。

usage.en: Often about love, or any peak experience that makes everything else seem ordinary.
usage.zh: 多用于爱情，也可指经历过极致后觉得其他平淡无奇。

text: 慈母手中线，游子身上衣
pinyin: cí mǔ shǒu zhōng xiàn, yóu zǐ shēn shàng yī
literal: kind · mother · hand · in · thread, wandering · son · body · on · clothes
natural: The kind mother's thread in her hand is the clothes on her wandering son's back

meaning.en: A mother's love is stitched into the clothes her child wears away from home.
meaning.zh: 慈母手中的针线，缝成远行儿子身上的衣服，体现母爱。

equivalents: a mother's love stitched into clothes

examples.zh: 母亲节的贺卡上写着“慈母手中线，游子身上衣”。
examples.en: The Mother's Day card was written with '§'.

examples.zh: 拎着妈妈缝的外套，我想起“慈母手中线，游子身上衣”。
examples.en: Holding the coat Mum had sewn, I thought of '§'.

story.en: Meng Jiao wrote the poem after taking a post late in life and fetching his mother to live with him, recalling her love.
story.zh: 孟郊中年得官，迎母同住，作此诗感念母爱。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 谁言寸草心，报得三春晖
pinyin: shuí yán cùn cǎo xīn, bào dé sān chūn huī
literal: who · say · inch · grass · heart, repay · can · three · spring · sunshine
natural: Who says the heart of a little blade of grass can repay the spring sunshine?

meaning.en: A child can never repay a parent's love, like grass to the sun.
meaning.zh: 谁说小草的心意能报答春天的阳光，比喻子女难以报答父母的恩情。

examples.zh: “谁言寸草心，报得三春晖”，父母的恩情永远报答不完。
examples.en: '§': we can never fully repay our parents.

examples.zh: 毕业演讲中，他引用“谁言寸草心，报得三春晖”感谢父母。
examples.en: In his graduation speech he quoted '§' to thank his parents.

story.en: The closing couplet of 'Song of the Wandering Son', comparing a child's gratitude to a blade of grass facing the sun.
story.zh: 《游子吟》结尾二句，以寸草与春晖喻子女与母亲。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花
pinyin: chūn fēng dé yì mǎ tí jí, yī rì kàn jìn cháng ān huā
literal: spring · breeze · pleased · horse · hooves · swift, one · day · see · all · Chang'an · flowers
natural: In the spring breeze of success the horse's hooves fly; in one day I see all of Chang'an's flowers

meaning.en: The elation of success; used for exam triumphs and proud, joyful moments.
meaning.zh: 春风得意，马蹄飞快，一天看遍长安的花，形容考中后的得意心情。

equivalents: the joy of passing the exam

examples.zh: 拿到录取通知书，他简直“春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花”。
examples.en: Getting his admission letter, he was truly '§'.

examples.zh: 新股上市大涨，投资人个个“春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花”。
examples.en: The new stock soared, and investors were all '§'.

story.en: Meng Jiao, after failing twice, finally passed the jinshi exam in 796 at the age of forty-six, and wrote of his joy.
story.zh: 孟郊屡试不第，46岁登进士第，喜而作此诗。

usage.en: Often used with a slightly ironic edge for self-satisfied success.
usage.zh: 有时带点调侃，形容志得意满。

text: 松下问童子，言师采药去
pinyin: sōng xià wèn tóng zǐ, yán shī cǎi yào qù
literal: pine · beneath · ask · boy, say · teacher · pick · herbs · gone
natural: Beneath the pine I ask the boy; he says his master has gone to gather herbs

meaning.en: Going to visit someone only to find them out; the classic 'missed the hermit' scene.
meaning.zh: 在松树下问童子，说师父采药去了，指访人不遇。

equivalents: called on him but he was out
a visit that finds no one home

examples.zh: 我上门拜访，结果“松下问童子，言师采药去”。
examples.en: I went to call on him, only to find '§'.

examples.zh: 教授不在，学生说他出差了，真是“松下问童子，言师采药去”。
examples.en: The professor wasn't in; the student said he was away: just '§'.

story.en: Jia Dao calls at a hermit's hut in the mountains and only meets the boy attendant; the poem is traditionally attributed to him.
story.zh: 贾岛访隐者不遇，仅问得童子之言。

usage.en: Used humorously when you call on someone who is out.
usage.zh: 访人不遇时常带幽默地引用。
